It would fail identically for any future unit that legitimately edits `design/`.

This is a structural defect in a leftover test from a different unit, not a regression caused by incorrect work here — the current unit's own required changes are exactly what trips it. Per my instructions I won't touch anything under `test/` to silence it. Flagging for the orchestrator/reviewer to decide whether to scope or retire that assertion.
